_about: Music identity (List 35, #344): the identity layer the programme's sound machinery (#84, #215, #72, #2) was missing — a THEME RECORD per subject (major human / species / place) holding an identity brief and a motif, with arrangements as versioned realisations under the current-version law (one CURRENT per theme per use class; supersessions named; no quiet fallback). SA2's construction is the model; every note is ours.

briefShapes.human: who they are / what they want / what they are hiding (the third fact is the SA2 lesson: a theme stating only the surface is a jingle)
briefShapes.place: what it is / what it was / what it promises — read against #215's bed layers, so theme and bed are one composition at two scales
briefShapes.species: motif SHAPE, not psychology — the contour facts of its cry (#2's parameter block); a species' cry IS its theme-seed

creatures.law: voice law binds music: a creature never sings words and never performs its theme; the ORCHESTRA may carry a species' motif (the world's music about the creature), the creature's own voice stays #2's synth, cries only
creatures.schemaFence: a species theme record has NO vocal version class — refused in the schema, #293's fence shape

places: #215's bed record gains a motif ref (proposal into #215's home): the bed's place layer is arranged from the place motif; phase/weather layers arrange around it, never replace it

fields: subject (ref to the subject's own record — themes attach, never float free)
motif (interval/contour/rhythm facts — the identity; everything else is arrangement)
versions[] (each: use class + realisation ref + CURRENT marker)
record.homes: humans → bible/casting docs; species → sheet annex (motif derived from #2's block); places → #215's record
record.reScoring: a subject whose canon changes gets a NEW version with the supersession named — never a silent re-score; per-use currency (an old version can stay CURRENT for an earlier season's use class)

versioning: current-version law applied to themes exactly as to art: exactly one CURRENT per theme per use class; #156's promo currency gate reads these markers
